The liquid lacks realistic surface tension details and refraction. It looks more like matte clay or plastic spheres than a viscous fluid like coffee.
The elliptical perspective of the cup rim seems slightly inconsistent with the angle of the incoming splash, suggesting a minor compositing or generation alignment error.
